body.name: Continuous cap-shell witness
body.construction: For \(0<\rho<\min\{h,1-c\}\) and \(h<c\), take \(U\) with \(P(U\le t)=(t/h)^\alpha\) on \([0,h]\), set \(X=U\), \(e(X)=c-U\), draw \(A\mid X\sim\mathrm{Bernoulli}(e(X))\), and set \(\mu_0=0\), \(\mu_1=1\), and \(Y=A\) under \(P_{\mathrm{lf}}\); set \(s=e+\rho\), \(u_0=\mu_0\), and \(u_1=\mu_1\) in \(\eta_{\mathrm{lf}}\).
